# DynCxt-Code-LLM-SLR

**Replication Package:** Systematic Literature Review on the Impact of Dynamic Context Management on Structural Quality and Functional Correctness of Code Generated by LLMs at the Repository Level.

## 📌 Repository Contents

1. **`primary_studies.bib`**: BibTeX file containing full reference records for all 26 included primary studies.
2. **`data/`**:
   - `quality_assessment.csv`: Quality assessment matrix evaluating studies against metrics QA-1 to QA-5.
   - `data_extraction.csv`: Extracted evidence matrix covering all 17 structured fields across the 26 included studies.
3. **`search/`**:
   - `search_queries.md`: Complete search strings, boolean logic, and execution parameters applied across ACM Digital Library, Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore.
   - `raw/`: Unfiltered search export files from the four digital databases (`acm.bib`, `ieee.bib`, `scopus.bib`, and `wos.ris`).
4. **`protocol/`**:
   - `protocolo_parsifal.pdf`: Complete SLR protocol and execution summary exported from Parsifal (in Portuguese).

## 🔗 Protocol Registration
The experimental protocol for this SLR was registered and managed on the [Parsifal](https://parsif.al/) platform.
